title: ID0374749-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP / S3 170003435] KF1 critical program error detected
description:
Location:
Leksand
Reported behaviour/issue:
All outlets were OOO due to “-KF1 critical program error detected” fault flag. After reboot, charger never came back online. Had the same issue on two chargers this weekend. I had to localy power off the chargers and after that they came online and worked again.
Screen was black on site and leds where red.
Root cause: FW Bug
Solution: PLC Reboot
Warranty:
FW Version:
v5.0.19-0-g531ce4f
Notes from ES to NOC [ 30/08/2024]

additional_info.subject: Please downgrade this charger to 4.11 according to RETOPICS Hotfix
RE: ID0374749-DC/Si-D/SE-[MP / S3 170003435] KF1 critical program error detected CRM:00642001413
additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus,
I hope all is well with you. As the charger is working fine now and the issue is already addressed by FW v 5.0.21, which is going to be released by CW 38, I am proceeding to close the ticket. Please be aware that this issue can be temporarily resolved by rebooting the PLC part of the charger via SSH. So in case you observe the same issue, please raise a ticket to get the support.
In case this error becomes severe and affects the charger operation, please plan to downgrade the charger by either Cfast card flashing or request remote support to roll back the previous FW.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sambath.K.S
